MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 82
   C. 81
   D. 9

2. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 170

3. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 7

4. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 2
   C. 14
   D. 49

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 14
   C. 12
   D. 2

6. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

7. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

8. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

9. Solve for x: x + 5 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 13
   C. 17
   D. 5

10. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 42

11. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 22

12. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 36
   D. 18

13. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 24

14. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 13
   C. 37
   D. 5

15. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 25

16. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
